questions.q: (a) Solve 3x² + 7x - 2 = 0 to 2 d.p. [3] (b) Solve y = 2x - 1 and y = x² - 4 [4] (c) Solve 3/(x - 1) + 2/(x + 1) = 2 [4] (d) Write x² + 8x + 5 in the form (x + p)² + q [3]
Show that the line y = 2x + 5 does not meet the curve y = x² + 2x + 9.
questions.a: x² + 9 = 5 gives x² = -4: no real solutions, so they do not meet

questions.q: Solve x² - 6x + 11 = 0 by completing the square, or show it has no real roots.
questions.model: x² - 6x + 11 = (x - 3)² - 9 + 11 = (x - 3)² + 2. A square plus 2 is never 0, so no real roots.
